usage.callShape: POST https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/cron/create with JSON body {action, schedule, payload}
usage.outputShape: On success expect a created-job object (job id + schedule); on error body.error is the field-level validation message and body.validActions lists allowed action enums.
quirks: inputSchema in registry is null - the real required fields are action, schedule, payload (a naive {name,url,method} body returns 400 'Missing required fields: action, schedule, payload')

action must be one of a fixed enum, NOT a free string: batch.execute, payroll.execute, swap.execute, bridge.execute, webhook.trigger, notify.email, notify.sms, xmtp.send, analytics.snapshot, invoice.remind
schedule is a standard 5-field cron expression (e.g. '0 0 * * *')
payload is an object whose shape depends on the chosen action (e.g. for webhook.trigger: {url, method})
endpoint charges $0.01 per POST even on a 400 validation error - get the body shape right BEFORE paying
x402 paid on Base USDC (also accepts Solana USDC); responses are sync, no async job polling for the create call itself
usage.guide: Create a scheduled cron job by POSTing to https://gateway.spraay.app/api/v1/cron/create with JSON {action, schedule, payload}. The action MUST be one of the fixed enum values (webhook.trigger, notify.email, notify.sms, swap.execute, payroll.execute, bridge.execute, xmtp.send, analytics.snapshot, invoice.remind, batch.execute) - a free-text action returns 400 with the validActions list. schedule is a 5-field cron expression; payload is an action-specific object (e.g. {url, method} for webhook.trigger). Pay is $0.01 USDC on Base via x402 per call, charged even on validation errors, so get the body right first. This schedules a recurring outward action that will fire on its own, so treat it as irreversible and confirm intent before creating real jobs.
